en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Rabi’e, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dissimulation (Taqiyya) (is to be done) during every necessity, and its performer is more knowing with it where he should be indulging in it’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Rib’i from Zurara from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Al-Taqiyyah (protective measures) is for when and wherever needed and the one involved in it knows best how to apply it.”
